# QuickPDFHD

QuickPDFHD is a free, browser-based set of PDF and image tools. Users can convert, split, merge, and package documents without creating an account.

## Main pages

- [All Services](https://quickpdfhd.com/all-services): Directory of available QuickPDFHD tools.
- [Home](https://quickpdfhd.com/): PDF tools and upload interface.
- [Word to PDF](https://quickpdfhd.com/word-to-pdf): Convert DOC and DOCX files to PDF.
- [PDF to Word](https://quickpdfhd.com/pdf-to-word): Extract selectable PDF text to DOCX.
- [Excel to PDF](https://quickpdfhd.com/excel-to-pdf): Convert XLS and XLSX worksheets to PDF.
- [PDF to Excel](https://quickpdfhd.com/pdf-to-excel): Extract PDF tables to XLSX.
- [Split PDF](https://quickpdfhd.com/split-pdf): Extract pages or split a PDF into smaller files.
- [Merge PDF](https://quickpdfhd.com/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files.
- [PDF to JPG](https://quickpdfhd.com/pdf-to-jpg): Render PDF pages as JPG images.
- [JPG to PDF](https://quickpdfhd.com/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG images to PDF.
- [JPEG to PDF](https://quickpdfhd.com/jpeg-to-pdf): Convert JPEG images to PDF.
- [PNG to PDF](https://quickpdfhd.com/png-to-pdf): Convert PNG images to PDF.
- [WEBP to PDF](https://quickpdfhd.com/webp-to-pdf): Convert WEBP images to PDF.
- [Document Scanner](https://quickpdfhd.com/document-scanner): Clean document photos and create a PDF.
- [PDF to ZIP](https://quickpdfhd.com/pdf-to-zip): Package multiple PDF files in one ZIP archive.
- [Resize Image](https://quickpdfhd.com/resize-image): Resize JPG, PNG, and WEBP images.
